glossary.name: Glossary

settings.allowEditing: Authors may change and delete their entries
settings.allowDuplicates: The same concept may be entered more than once
settings.autoLink: Link concepts in the course's texts to their entries

glossary.notFound: The entry is not in the glossary or is not available to you.

ratings.title: Entry ratings
ratings.hint: Teachers rate approved entries; nobody rates their own. The grade of a student is made from the ratings of their entries. Turning ratings off removes the gradebook item with its grades.

rating.rateLabel: Your rating of the entry by {name}
